name: stockcurve SPACEX pre-IPO (Tessera)
description: stockcurve pre-IPO demo pool token: 1 pSPACEX = 0.001 of a Tessera T-SpaceX token-unit, launched atomically on a Meteora Dynamic Bonding Curve quoted in USDC with the curve anchored to Tessera's T-SpaceX mark price and monitored against PreStocks' SPACEX mark and secondary price. The two issuers value SpaceX 2.3x apart; a neutral curve is the venue for that question. Hackathon demo (Stocklana 2026); not a claim on SpaceX equity or on any Tessera or PreStocks token.
